skill_name: How can you improve air quality indoors?
workflow: Indoor air quality can be improved by taking several measures. First, controlling the sources of pollutants indoors is key. This includes reducing the use of products such as aerosol sprays, cleaning products, and pesticides. It is also important to ensure proper ventilation and circulation of air to reduce concentration of pollutants in the home.
